sentences.en: Why do women want to sleep in a man's embrace?
sentences.zh: 为什么女人想要在男人的怀抱中入睡？

sentences.en: Don't embrace me in such a manner. I'm so frail!
sentences.zh: 别这样拥抱我。我太脆弱了！

sentences.en: Shall I stay like this until morning embracing you?
sentences.zh: 我会一直抱着你等到天亮吗？

senses.zh: 包括；包含 - 接受 - 信奉，皈依 -

mnemonic: 词根记忆：em（进入…之中）+brace（两臂）→进入两臂→拥抱
